stimulus.body: Dans un exercice de français, le professeur demande de choisir la forme qui convient d'après la règle de la leçon.

questions.stem: At a planning meeting, a surveyor notes the evidence: Quelle réponse applique correctement la règle de la leçon ?

options.text: The staff canteen menu.
The office furniture colour.
The annual holiday destination.
Overtime rates and night-shift premiums.

questions.explanation: Overtime rates and night premiums are core pay conditions and normal negotiation subjects. The key is D, "Overtime rates and night-shift premiums". Option A ("The staff canteen menu") is wrong: confuses perk with pay. Option B ("The office furniture colour") is wrong: confuses perk with pay. Option C ("The annual holiday destination") is wrong: confuses perk with pay.

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: The procedure that protects an employee facing dismissal

stimulus.body: Dans un exercice de français, le professeur demande de choisir la forme qui convient d'après la règle de la leçon.

questions.stem: In a lab report, a surveyor notes the evidence: Quelle réponse applique correctement la règle de la leçon ?

options.text: The employee gets a preliminary interview to respond first.
The employee can be dismissed instantly by email.
The team votes on the dismissal.
The union decides the outcome.

questions.explanation: The core protection is a preliminary interview allowing the employee to respond before dismissal. The key is A, "The employee gets a preliminary interview to respond first". Option B ("The employee can be dismissed instantly by email") is wrong: removes all protection. Option C ("The team votes on the dismissal") is wrong: confuses workplace with procedure. Option D ("The union decides the outcome") is wrong: gives union decisive power.
